comparison.objective: Safely isolate, disconnect, and blank a pneumatic line; candidate commissions a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Valve/padlock/dump operation, collet depression, tube extraction, and plug insertion versus tool-based unlock-adjust-relock and dynamic-response tuning.
comparison.success_condition: Depressurized, disconnected, plugged port with supply isolated versus repeated carriage stops without hard-stop strike, overload, rebound, or setting drift.
comparison.reason: All eight indexed spec versions were read, including the lock-and-bleed variants; the candidate does not test pneumatic release or blanking.
